name: TSDF Fusion Mesh Extraction
aliases: TSDF Volume Integration from Gaussian Splatting Outputs
definition: Performs Truncated Signed Distance Function (TSDF) fusion using Open3D's ScalableTSDFVolume to extract a mesh from 2D Gaussian Splatting depth and color maps within a fixed depth range.
summary: TSDF Fusion Mesh Extraction reconstructs 3D triangle meshes by explicitly fusing multi-view depth maps into a TSDF volume, differing from neural rendering by avoiding differentiable surface optimization.
